summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SmartExpense app - all core functionality working correctly. Backend APIs fully functional, frontend UI responsive and integrated properly with backend.
passed_tests: User registration with JWT token generation
Dashboard overview cards display (total balance, monthly spending, active budgets, upcoming bills)
Default categories auto-creation on registration (6 categories)
Expense CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
Expense form with all fields (amount, date, category, payment method, note, receipt upload)
Expense list with search and category filters
Category management (create, delete with icon and color)
Budget management (create, delete with progress tracking)
Analytics charts (pie chart for spending by category, line chart for spending over time)
Protected routes (redirects to auth when not logged in)
Backend API authentication and error handling
